messages.subject: shiny app works locally but output shows error when deployed in shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,

The App is displayed but the main output panel shows an error (that is not present when running the app locally) 

"Error: XML content does not seem to be XML:..."

The error is seems to be related to the xml package attempting to extract online xml data (I had figured this out locally though so not sure about why there is error after being deployed).

Here is the link to the deployed app:
https://acdelre.shinyapps.io/shiny_budget/

The ui.R and server.R files are attached to this email.

Any assistance is much appreciated.

AC
